description: Requests a free Cnamio account for an email address. Cnamio emails a link to that address, and only opening it creates the account (a test application on the simulated sandbox provider and a live application on the free plan); an address that already has an account gets a sign-in link instead, and the answer is the same in both cases. Requires consent: true, meaning the address owner agreed to https://cnamio.com/terms and https://cnamio.com/privacy. Returns received: true and the next steps; the application secret is never returned (it is generated in the dashboard). The answer also carries a 30-minute sandbox session (sandbox).

consent.description: true: that person agreed to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

email.description: The email address of the person the account is for.

locale.description: Language of the email and the dashboard.

name: start_signup
title: Start a free Cnamio account
